bullets: Be the Voice of the Customer: Articulate customer simulation workflows, bottlenecks, and expectations to our core product, AI research, and engineering teams.
Workflow & Capability Benchmarking: Map out how customers use current tools for thermal, CFD, and thermoelastic analysis, and where legacy tools fail or force compromises.
Validate Real-World Usecases: Ensure Vinci’s outputs, UI/UX flows, and configuration paradigms (e.g., handling complex ECAD/GDSII/STEP inputs, layer stackups, and power maps)…
Support Pre-Sales & Pilots: Speak peer-to-peer with prospect simulation leads, speaking fluently about their current setup and demonstrating how Vinci accelerates their simulation…
